items.stem: How does web code in a Capacitor app invoke a native device feature such as the camera?

options.text: Through a Capacitor plugin that bridges JavaScript calls to native code
options.rationale: Correct: plugins expose a JavaScript API that the Capacitor bridge forwards to native implementations.

options.text: By running native Swift or Kotlin directly inside the web view
options.rationale: Web views run web code; native code runs behind the bridge, not inside the view.

options.text: It cannot; hybrid apps have no access to native features
options.rationale: Hybrid apps reach native features precisely through the plugin bridge.

options.text: By reinstalling the app for each feature
options.rationale: Reinstalling is unrelated to how a feature is invoked.

items.explanation: Correct: plugins expose a JavaScript API that the Capacitor bridge forwards to native implementations.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Ionic's platform-adaptive styling are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Components can render with iOS or Android conventions depending on the platform
options.rationale: Correct: Ionic adapts component appearance to match each platform's conventions.

options.text: A shared theme can define colours and variables reused across platforms
options.rationale: Correct: theming through CSS variables is shared and reused.

options.text: Styling must be rewritten natively for each platform
options.rationale: Styling is defined once in web CSS, not rewritten natively.

items.explanation: Correct: Ionic adapts component appearance to match each platform's conventions.

items.stem: After changing the web build, which Capacitor step makes the change appear in the native app?

options.text: Copy/sync the web assets into the native projects, then run them
options.rationale: Correct: the sync workflow copies the built web assets into the native projects before they run.

options.text: Nothing; native apps read the web source folder live
options.rationale: Native apps run copied assets, not the live source folder.

options.text: Resubmit to the app store for every local change
options.rationale: Store submission is not needed to test a synced change locally.

options.text: Delete the native folders and regenerate the whole project
options.rationale: A routine sync suffices; regenerating everything is unnecessary.

items.explanation: Correct: the sync workflow copies the built web assets into the native projects before they run.
